proposal.why: 在2026年，随着Agent处理长上下文需求的激增，如何高效利用有限的上下文窗口成为工程实践的核心痛点。本站软件与Agent主线高度相关，该词直指系统性能优化，且与当前词形成互补而非重复。证据来源权威，时效性强，能引导读者关注具体的token管理和检索策略，具备实际落地价值。

evidence.title: What is Context Engineering? A Guide to AI Context Optimization
evidence.claim: Context engineering is the practice of designing and managing the information provided to AI models to improve their outputs.

evidence.title: The Rise of Context Engineering
evidence.claim: Context engineering is becoming a critical skill for AI engineers as models become more context-aware.

candidates.notes: Directly related to current word but with fresh evidence and slightly different angle.

evidence.title: Optimizing Context Windows: Techniques and Best Practices
evidence.claim: Effective context window optimization can reduce token usage by up to 30% while maintaining performance.

evidence.title: How to Optimize Context Windows for LLM Applications
evidence.claim: Context window optimization involves techniques like chunking, summarization, and selective retrieval.

candidates.notes: Distinct from Context Engineering as it focuses on the technical limits of the window itself.

evidence.title: Adaptive Context Management in AI Agents
evidence.claim: Adaptive context management dynamically adjusts what information is retained and retrieved based on the task at hand.

evidence.title: Building Self-Improving Agents with Adaptive Context
evidence.claim: IBM researchers propose adaptive context management as a key component for autonomous agents.

candidates.notes: A more advanced concept that goes beyond static context engineering.

evidence.title: Contextual Memory Systems for LLM Agents
evidence.claim: Contextual memory systems enable agents to retain and recall relevant information across sessions.

evidence.title: The Role of Memory in Context Engineering
evidence.claim: Memory systems are essential for long-term context management in agentic applications.

candidates.notes: Focuses on the memory aspect of context, which is a hot topic in agent design.

evidence.title: Prompt Contextualization: Tailoring Prompts for Better AI Responses
evidence.claim: Prompt contextualization involves adding relevant background information to prompts to guide model behavior.

evidence.title: Contextualized Prompts: Key to Unlocking LLM Potential
evidence.claim: Contextualized prompts can significantly improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations.

candidates.notes: A narrower technique under the umbrella of context engineering, but with distinct focus.
